tool: scratch randomized model (not part of the project): 1,500 random actions per run — buys, sells, kid and parent cancels, purchases, deposits, loans, Yahoo refreshes, scheduled maintenance, parent manual closes, manual rolls and time jumps
truthModel: each stock trades on real exchange days (HK general holidays after 2027 unknown to the app), plus random special market closures and 1–12-day suspensions; Yahoo per symbol either fails (~15%), lags 1–2 sessions (~15%), or returns the complete daily series
invariants: cash equals the ledger sum; no negative cash or available balance
reserved cash equals pending buy budgets
positions, cost basis and realized P&L equal a chronological replay of fills
every order not rolled by hand keeps its placement-time session as rolledFrom/targetDate and never moves backwards
every fill uses the first real close at or after that session, at that day's true price
no fill uses a close that was already final when the order was submitted
after a final full Yahoo refresh no order is left pending

sameModelOnV2_0_1.note: V2.0.1 keeps every order behind a session without a close waiting; V2.0.2 fills them at the first later close
